categories.play: technical commentary in the manner of snooker, chess and cricket

notes: All lines are invented, deadpan nonsense and have no connection to real play.
Lines name no live game state, so any line may be chosen at random. Filter by category for weighted selection.
Historical events, tournaments, places and people are fictional.
Written as an affectionate pastiche of radio and television sports commentary.
